origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.name: Ko te Rōpū
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.description: He uri tawhiti o nga Ghosts i whakaorangia mai i te Nether, a he tangata ake i te mea kua roa o raatau kitenga ki te Ao Tuarua.
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.name: Ko te tangata onepu
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.description: Ko te iwi onepu te iwi onepu e noho ana i te onepu.
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.name: Te Kaitohutohu wairua
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.descript: Ko tētahi momo tangata e āhei ana ki te whakawhiti i tō rātou pūngao wairua.
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.name: Ko te Wraith Whiring
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.descr: Ko te hawhe-ora, ko te hawhe-kore-mate e whakakotahi ana i nga mana mate tonu i te hua o te whakakotahitanga ki nga waro mate.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.name: He ngoikore te tinana
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.descri: Ahakoa kua rite ake koe ki te Ao Tuarua, he ngoikore koe i te tinana, he ngoikore ake koe i te kohatu, he 25% iti ake te kino o te whawhai, ā, ka tere te ngenge.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.name: Ko te Whakaaturanga o te Pūoro ahi
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.descr: Ahakoa i mahue koe i te ao o runga, kua mau tonu koe i te kaha o ō tupuna ki te pupuhi i te ahi, i te iti rawa.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.name: Ko te utu
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.descri: Ko te peke i te wā e hīkoi ana ka meinga e koe kia pupuhi, kia rere ake hoki koe mō te wā poto.
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.name: Ki Te Whakaaetanga
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.descripti: He kaha tō ātete ki te kino makutu.
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.name: Ko te Poari ahi o te wairua
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.description: Whakauruhia he pōro ahi wairua motuhake e piki ake ana i te kaha ka piki ake to taumata wheako (nui atu i te taumata 100).
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_attributes.de: Kia iti ake te kino i te wā e tu ana koe i runga i ngā kōpae onepu, engari kia 50% noa iho te kino i te wā e tu ana koe i runga i tētahi mea kē atu i te onepu.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.name: Te Whakanoho i te Onepu
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.desc: Ka taea e koe te keri i a koe ki te onepu.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_shovel_damage: Kia 150% atu te kino o nga pahua.
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.name: Wairua tere
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.descriptio: Ko te pūngao wairua i roto i te onepu wairua me te oneone wairua e āhei ana koe ki te tere haere.
power.ibarnorigins.soulfire_strength.nam: Te Mana o te Rangatiratanga o te wairua
power.ibarnorigins.soulfire_strength.des: Whakahaerehia he 50% nui ake o te kino i te wa e tu ana i te taha o nga puna ahi wairua, e pupuri ana ranei i a raatau taonga e whai ake nei.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_fireweakness: Ahakoa e pai ana koe i te taha o te ahi wairua, he kaha te pā o te ahi o te rama me te ahi puni ki a koe.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_piglinfear.d: Ko te mura wairua taketake e tahu ana i roto i a koe e whakauruhia ana te wehi ki roto i nga Piglins katoa engari ko nga tino maia.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_vegetarian.n: Ko te kai huawhenua e manakohia ana
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_vegetarian.d: E kore te kikokiko e nui te pūngao o te wairua rite ki nga huawhenua.
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.name: Ko te Whakatairanga me te Kahu
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.descripti: Whakahaerehia nga kaha o te hunga mate-kore, me te whakaingoa i nga kopere maroke e rapu ana i o hoariri.
power.ibarnorigins.wp_item_prevention.de: E kore koe e ahei ki te mau i tetahi whakangungu rakau teitei ake i te whakangungu rakau rino.
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.name: Te rere
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.description: He tino maama tō tinana, ā, ka taea e koe te kaukau i roto i te rangi.
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.name: Te ngoikore
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.description: Na tō hono hono, ka tino ngoikore tō tinana (5 ngā ngakau) ā, kāore koe e kaha ki te whakaputa i te nui o te kino o te pūāhua.
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.name: Nga Whakapā Whakapā
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.description: Mā te pānga katoa ka pā te pānga o te mate ki ō hoa riri.
